periods.description: The Sword Device Fugil gives young Lisha during the burning of the Arcadia imperial castle; it becomes the symbol of her survival and Drag-Ride path.

details.origin: given by fugil-arcadia in the Arcadia castle courtyard
details.function: summons and controls a paired Armored Drag-Ride

history: Thrown to young Lisha by Fugil during the castle fire
Lisha later becomes a Divine Drag-Ride user and engineer
